wiki.title: Meg Froelich
wiki.extract: Meg M. Froelich is an American politician serving as a member of the Colorado House of Representatives from the 3rd district, which includes [[Englewood, Colorado], [Sheridan, Colorado], and [Denver, Colorado]]. Froelich assumed office on January 14, 2019.
